name: Neachdan
role: the Mason (An Clachair); broke the vein, carried the first fire home
notes: canon I-0001; born some 27 years before the count; head of the Line of the Mason

name: Sorcha
role: wife of Neachdan; first to be burned by the hearth

name: Conall mac Neachdain
role: son of Neachdan; kept the burning vein
notes: canon (App. A); a boy of six at VE 1

name: Ailbhe nic Neachdain
role: daughter of Neachdan, the first child born by a hearth; the fire-bearer who carried fire to the hearths of the hills

name: Tadhg
role: elder of the household of the black well; first to claim the mason's crack for his well

name: Muirne
role: of Conall's line; keeper of the vein-fire when it died; bade them lay the slab

name: Conn
role: herder who followed the shrinking snow up the Abhainn uaine

name: Eachna
role: laid the first hearths at Achadh dhìreach

name: Luag
role: walker who went to the north-western horn and found no tree and no hearth

name: Gràinne
role: last to leave her hearth on the drowned neck of Eilean dhubh

name: Oisean
role: seal-hunter of the south shore; first to cross open water on purpose, to Eilean mhin

name: Scàire
role: seal-hunter of the north shore; took seals on the skerries off Eilean fhada; saw the grey on the northern sea

name: Fionnghuala
role: mother of Diarmad; keeper of the fire-pot

name: Diarmad
role: of the Mason's line; asked why the coal has colours; heard the Telling and the riddle from the Keeper; fixed the recital of the Line

name: Niamh
role: wife of Diarmad

name: Deirbhile nic Dhiarmaid
role: daughter of Diarmad; kept the Telling word for word and taught it

name: Muirgheal
role: old woman of the line who wept at the gold coal's lighting

name: Aodh
role: of the Mason's line; threw the seven into the sea; the gold coal took fire

name: Gormal
role: woman of the line; kept the pot and the recital in the lean years

name: Mathan
role: brother of Fearghas; climbed the height with him
notes: not a father of the direct Line

name: Fearghas
role: of the Mason's line; let the six fall from the highest ground; the snowflake coal took fire

name: Bran
role: steersman of the north-west shore who sailed west for an isle of the blessed and did not come back

name: Blàthnaid
role: sister of Bran; kept his telling hushed

name: Brian
role: of the Mason's line; grave-digger; buried the five; the black coal was warm

name: Caoimhe
role: wife of Brian

name: Criomthann
role: lit the warning fire on the north-western headland

name: Eimhir
role: herder girl of the Doire uaine hills who found the cut lines

name: Laoghaire
role: dug the first covered hearth in the Doire uaine hills

name: Sadhbh
role: hunter of the east, one of the three who saw the white stag and did not draw

name: Muireall
role: child who went past the line of stones at Coille Naomh Cnoc bheag and was never found

name: Cormac
role: of the Mason's line, 'of the Misstrike'; his blood lit the mahogany coal in the grove

name: Dubhghall
role: drove the red deer in the eastern woods; his grandson buried a dog at Cnoc fhionn

name: Eòghann
role: of the Mason's line; tasted the river; the silver coal took fire under the water

name: Rathnait
role: woman of the line who heard the households first name themselves Clann nan Dè

name: Barabal
role: of Àth gharbh, not of the line; burnt a sliver of coloured coal in her peat fire

name: Giorsal
role: of Achadh dhìreach; rubbed broken coal into the wool of the dead

name: Oscar
role: wit of Àth gharbh who named the line the Inquisitors of the Mystic Coal

name: Colla
role: of the Mason's line; in his days the line took the name Clann na Ceiste

name: Lughaidh
role: shepherd of the west who saw Carragh Cnoc bheag standing new

name: Mòrnait
role: woman of Clann na Ceiste who kept fire at the ring about Colbh Cnoc chiar

name: Ciannait
role: of the hills; heard the saying first spoken at the column

name: Seathan
role: of Clann na Ceiste; snapped his fingers and the fire coal's dust took fire

name: Caitir
role: wife of Seathan

name: Aoife
role: mother of the child buried with a sliver of the coal at Tuam Cnoc dhìreach
notes: I-0076; the child is not named

name: Cairbre
role: led the eleven from the southern shore into the hills in the crossing season

name: Suibhne
role: of Clann na Ceiste, father of Ailean; tried the rainbow coal in the grove

name: Ailean mac Shuibhne
role: of Clann na Ceiste; lit the six again and brought them to the grove; the Keeper lit the rainbow
notes: canon I-0080a; living at the close; never 'Ailean Mòr' in this volume

name: Lìobhan
role: wife of Ailean, mother of Gormshuil

name: Gormshuil nic Ailein
role: infant daughter of Ailean, born before the grove
notes: canon (Age II, I-0084); only her birth in this volume
